# Last.fm Animated Track Wall

> A static website that shows a Last.fm user's top album art as an animated, vertically scrolling wall.

Open the site with `?username=<last.fm username>` added to the URL. The page calls the Last.fm API from the browser for that user's top 100 albums over the last 12 months. Without a username, the page shows short usage instructions. The site is a static Next.js export served by a Cloudflare Worker. It has no server and stores no data.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/delta1513/lastfmwall.deltadelta.dev): Source code for the site
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/delta1513/lastfmwall.deltadelta.dev/main/README.md): What the site does and how to run it

## Optional

- [Last.fm user.getTopAlbums API](https://www.last.fm/api/show/user.getTopAlbums): The API method that the site uses
